ensure_ollama_model: ensure the Ollama model is available at the target Ollama endpoint by checking availability and downloading if needed
test_ollama_available: test if the Ollama service is available at the given URL endpoint
get_available_ollama_models: get a list of available Ollama models from the Docker Ollama container
download_ollama_model: download an Ollama model to the Docker container with progress monitoring and timeout
delete_ollama_model: delete an Ollama model from the Docker Ollama container by name
